args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** `checkout-api` was failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). `list_deployments` showed the release history: v2.2.9 (healthy) → v2.3.0 (healthy) → v2.3.1 (unhealthy in production), with v2.3.1-rc unhealthy in staging.
2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all regions. The rollback was verified (`status: rolled_out`).
3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.002.
